description: This file defines an interface named InvocationStrategyInterface in the Slim Framework, specifying a contract for invoking route callables with a standardized method __invoke that accepts a callable, request, response, and route arguments, returning a response object.

classes.name: InvocationStrategyInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for invoking route callables with the method __invoke() including parameters for callable, request, response, and route arguments.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invoke a route callable with specified request, response, and route arguments, returning a response object.
